Start cycling wallpapers from a directory

Usage: wayle wallpaper cycle [OPTIONS] <DIRECTORY>

Arguments:
  <DIRECTORY>  Directory containing wallpaper images

Options:
  -i, --interval <INTERVAL>  Interval in seconds between changes [default: 300]
  -m, --mode <MODE>          Cycling mode [default: sequential] [possible values: sequential, shuffle]
  -h, --help                 Print help (see more with '--help')
